title: Onboarding checklist home
description: A first-run home screen organized around a short checklist of 3-6 setup tasks, each with why it matters, an estimated effort, and a direct action. Progress persists across sessions; completed items collapse; the checklist can be dismissed once the core tasks are done and the regular home takes over.
intent: Get a new user to the first meaningful result with clear next steps instead of an empty dashboard or a product tour.
characteristics: 3-6 tasks ordered by dependency, first one already actionable
each task: title, reason, effort, primary action
progress shown as count ("2 of 5 done"), not only a bar
completed tasks collapse with a way to revisit
interaction: Tasks complete from real product events, not from clicking a checkbox; actions deep-link to the right screen and return; progress persists server-side.
responsive: Checklist is a single column at all sizes; secondary panels (help, sample data) move below it on narrow screens.
accessibility: Checklist is a list with each item status in text; progress has a text equivalent; collapse/expand uses disclosure buttons with aria-expanded; celebration motion respects reduced motion.
limitations: Only works if task completion can be detected; otherwise users tick boxes without doing the work.
Adds maintenance: tasks must change when the product changes.
